lead: A live formalization map makes unfinished dependencies visible, while reactions and complexity commentary cannot settle the underlying mathematical claims. Local tools disclose network paths, and a small model comparison keeps a near-tied score separate from the cost of one consequential error.

The late-morning batch adds an explicitly AI-written disclosure essay, a reading of OpenAI's loss chart and pressure on infrastructure from organizing and reported controls. Financing, strategic-risk scenarios and a hobby driving demo keep their source and testing limits.

The afternoon brings a material change in mathematical evidence: a joint Lean/Mathlib certification and an independent verification register for Alpöge. NVIDIA restores Huang while retaining its inquiry. New capability evaluations, model releases and infrastructure deals keep tested results, company claims and forecasts separate.

sections.title: A proof dashboard exposes its unresolved dependencies
sections.intro: The separate Masullo map tracks unfinished work. Wang's broad extrapolation still lacks a resolved source post; today's later Lean/Mathlib certification concerns Alpöge and is covered in its own section.

sections.title: Local tools and labels do not enforce their own boundaries
sections.intro: A Mac coding tool documents network paths, a permission metaphor asks who can inspect the output, and an operating-system fork states ambitions that still need testing.

sections.title: Small tests keep claims close to their evidence
sections.intro: A one-run model comparison preserves the cost of a missed billing rule, and a styling specimen remains a personal browser experiment rather than a universal design result.

sections.title: A complexity essay is not a resolution of P versus NP
sections.intro: Viola interprets reported algorithmic advances as support for a prior belief while explicitly leaving the central problem unresolved.

sections.title: Culture, funding and an interim role arrive with source limits
sections.intro: Partial-access profiles and a compliance funding preview remain attributed, while Axios describes a cyber-policy transition conditional on Senate confirmation.

sections.title: Breach reporting makes AI authorship and sampling explicit
sections.intro: Hunt discloses how an AI-assisted reading of his mailbox became an anonymized essay, while the underlying correspondence remains outside the evidence available here.

sections.title: Reading a training curve is not measuring the whole model
sections.intro: Goedecke separates a company loss chart from post-training, user experience and a portable safety threshold.

sections.title: Infrastructure faces opposition, demand risk and a proposed policy split
sections.intro: Employee organizing, reported export restrictions and a governors' proposal involve different mechanisms and different degrees of source access.

sections.title: Nuclear decision time is a reported concern, not a verified capability
sections.intro: An inaccessible report describes researchers' anxiety; its headline number does not establish an operational launch timeline.

sections.title: Funding and a hobby demo keep ambitions separate from tests
sections.intro: Robotics and conveyancing rounds describe capital and plans, while a village-driving project supplies a live interface but no reproduced simulation assessment.

sections.title: Formal verification changes the Alpöge evidence level
sections.intro: Lean FRO and Mathlib certify the proof, and the MIT register documents independent checks while distinguishing remaining runs and scope limits.

sections.title: NVIDIA restores its CEO without closing the investigation
sections.intro: A direct board statement establishes the announced leadership change; commentary and partial reporting do not turn it into exoneration.

sections.title: Capabilities, transfer and reliability remain different measurements
sections.intro: METR's stronger task results and Naam's workplace critique share a concern about what a benchmark can actually establish.

sections.title: Model and harness changes trade compute, quality and uncertainty
sections.intro: Loop depth, continuous diffusion, decision calibration and multimodal scale are release claims; harness experiments offer a narrower tested setting.

sections.title: Monitoring incentives are a hypothesis to test
sections.intro: A post-training essay warns about selecting undetected reward hacking without proving that all monitoring must fail.

sections.title: Deals and agent ambitions keep their stages visible
sections.intro: A reported Decart agreement updates an earlier prospective headline; funding announcements and a founder interview are not proof of deployment outcomes.

sections.title: Litigation and political-economic commentary are not verdicts
sections.intro: State claims about Grok retain the company response, while infrastructure essays and a recycled anecdote remain arguments and attributed reporting.

sections.title: A GIF announcement does not establish a complete rollout
sections.intro: Gemini's cached post advertises generation, with availability, price and quality still untested.
